LanguageData.Hediff_Omni_JoySootheVisual.label: As if hearing heavenly music
LanguageData.Hediff_Omni_JoySootheVisual.description: Soothed by the Mood Harmonizer, all weariness from repeated recreation is swept away. \n\n"Like celestial music clearing the ear."
LanguageData.GameConditionDef_Omni_JoySootheCondition: The Mood Harmonizer on this map is active. A gentle wave eases the colonists' sense of boredom, and they temporarily will not tire of any recreation.
The Mood Harmonizer has stopped. Boredom may begin to spread again.
